title: Example Service — landing
description: A demonstration service landing page used to compare USWDS with the OGDS hybrid.

panels.heading: Example only
panels.body: This is an independent comparison demo, not a government service. In production, this banner must accurately explain who operates the site.

panels.heading: Same content, two treatments
panels.body: The content and interaction are shared. Only the design-system layer changes between the two panes.

sections.heading: Get the support you need
sections.body: Apply for services, check the status of a request, and find clear guidance for the next step.

sections.heading: New: apply online
sections.body: You can now start an application online and return to it later. Save your reference number.

items.heading: Apply for support
items.body: Start a new request and find the documents you need before you apply.

items.heading: Check your status
items.body: Use your reference number to see what has been received and what happens next.

items.heading: Find guidance
items.body: Read plain-language guidance about eligibility, documents, and timelines.

items.question: How do I apply?
items.answer: Start with the online application. Review the document checklist first, then save your reference number when you submit.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Most requests receive an initial response within ten business days. Complex requests may take longer, and you can check the status at any time.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Email example@example.gov or call 555-0100, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
This is sample content for an independent design-system comparison. It is not a government service.
